title: US Officially Loses Measles-Free Status After Record Outbreak
subtitle: Health experts express deep concern as the nation reports thousands of cases and multiple deaths.

summary.en: The United States has officially lost its long-held measles-free status after a year of continuous virus spread. Global health authorities confirmed the change following a surge of over 5,400 cases and multiple deaths. Experts blame the decline on falling childhood vaccination rates and the spread of misinformation. While the government has promised to work toward regaining this status, political leaders are calling for accountability. The loss marks a significant setback for American public health efforts.
summary.zh: 美國在經歷了一年病毒持續傳播後，已正式失去維持已久的無麻疹國家地位。全球衛生當局在病例數激增至超過五千四百例並造成多人死亡後，確認了這項變更。專家將此衰退歸咎於兒童疫苗接種率下降以及錯誤資訊的散布。儘管政府已承諾致力於重拾此地位，政治領袖們仍呼籲追究責任。此次失去地位標誌著美國公共衛生工作遭遇了重大挫折。

paragraphs.en: The United States has officially lost its measles-free status, a designation that marks the end of 26 years without the disease spreading continuously within the country. The Pan American Health Organization (Paho), a regional branch of the World Health Organization, announced the decision this week after the virus spread for 12 months. This change comes during the worst measles outbreak in the US since 1991, with state health authorities reporting more than 5,400 cases and up to 10 deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 美國已正式失去「無麻疹國家」的地位，這項認定標誌著該國長達二十六年未出現麻疹持續傳播的紀錄正式終結。世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）的區域分支機構泛美衛生組織（Pan American Health Organization, Paho）在本週宣布了這項決定，此前該病毒已在美國境內持續傳播了十二個月。這項改變發生在美國自一九九一年以來最嚴重的麻疹疫情期間，各州衛生當局通報的病例數已超過五千四百例，並造成多達十人死亡。

paragraphs.en: Measles is one of the most contagious diseases known to medicine. To prevent outbreaks, at least 95 percent of a community must be vaccinated. While the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine is safe and highly effective, vaccination rates have dropped in recent years. Experts point to a combination of pandemic-era disruptions and the growth of misinformation as the primary reasons for this decline. According to The Guardian, the American Medical Association described the loss of this status as a "deeply troubling and entirely preventable setback for our nation."
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹是醫學界已知傳染性最強的疾病之一。為了預防疫情爆發，社區內至少必須有百分之九十五的人口接種疫苗。儘管麻疹、腮腺炎與德國麻疹混合疫苗（MMR疫苗）安全且極為有效，但近年來的疫苗接種率卻有所下降。專家指出，疫情期間的干擾與錯誤資訊的增加是導致接種率下滑的主要原因。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，美國醫學會（American Medical Association）形容失去這項地位是「對我國而言極度令人擔憂且完全可以避免的挫敗」。

paragraphs.en: For many public health professionals, the news is both sad and frustrating. Dr. Jon Andrus, who chaired the Paho advisory committee that recommended the change, told The Guardian that the decision was emotional because of the decades of hard work put into eliminating the disease. He noted that the US was once a global leader in this area. The loss of this status does not come with legal penalties or travel restrictions, but it serves as a formal recognition that the virus is now endemic, meaning it is regularly found within the population.
paragraphs.zh: 對於許多公共衛生專業人士來說，這則消息既令人悲傷又感到挫折。曾擔任泛美衛生組織諮詢委員會主席並建議做出此項變更的安德魯斯醫師（Dr. Jon Andrus）告訴《衛報》，由於過去數十年為消除該疾病所付出的艱辛努力，這項決定令他感觸良多。他指出，美國曾是該領域的全球領導者。失去這項地位雖不會帶來法律制裁或旅遊限制，但這是一項正式的認定，代表該病毒目前已成為地方性流行病，意即它已在人口中規律地出現。

paragraphs.en: The situation has led to intense political debate. Critics have directed significant blame toward the Trump administration and Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. for their role in spreading doubt about vaccine safety. Some high-profile epidemiologists have described the leadership’s approach to public health as "malpractice." Furthermore, several senators have called for Kennedy to be fired, with Republican Bill Cassidy of Louisiana labeling his time in office as "a series of failures."
paragraphs.zh: 此情況引發了激烈的政治辯論。批評者將矛頭指向川普（Trump）政府以及衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.），認為他們在散布對疫苗安全性的懷疑方面扮演了角色。一些知名流行病學家將政府領導層處理公共衛生的方式形容為「醫療疏失」。此外，多位參議員已要求將甘迺迪解職，來自路易斯安那州的共和黨參議員卡西迪（Bill Cassidy）更將其任期標籤為「一連串的失敗」。

paragraphs.en: In response to the criticism, Kennedy stated on social media that the US will work to stop outbreaks and regain its measles-free status. He emphasized that his department is working to close vaccination gaps and rebuild public trust. Kennedy added that he continues to recommend the MMR vaccine as the most effective way to prevent the disease. He promised that officials would answer families' questions honestly about the benefits and risks of vaccines while working with community leaders to limit the spread of the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 針對上述批評，甘迺迪在社群媒體上表示，美國將致力於遏止疫情並重拾無麻疹國家的地位。他強調，其部門正努力縮小疫苗接種差距並重建公眾信任。甘迺迪補充說，他持續推薦接種MMR疫苗，認為這是預防該疾病最有效的方式。他承諾官員們將誠實回答家庭對於疫苗益處與風險的疑問，同時與社區領袖合作，以限制病毒的傳播。

paragraphs.en: Despite these promises, experts warn that the problem is complex and cannot be blamed on a single administration. Misinformation regarding the MMR vaccine has been a challenge for more than two decades. Dr. Jarbas Barbosa da Silva Jr., the director of Paho, noted that the role of misinformation in the spread of the virus is "dynamic." He urged health departments to create specific campaigns that are tailored to the needs of communities with low vaccination rates.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些承諾，專家仍警告問題相當複雜，不能僅歸咎於單一政府。關於MMR疫苗的錯誤資訊已成為超過二十年來的挑戰。泛美衛生組織主任巴博薩醫師（Dr. Jarbas Barbosa da Silva Jr.）指出，錯誤資訊在病毒傳播中的角色是「動態的」。他敦促衛生部門制定具體的宣導活動，針對疫苗接種率較低社區的需求進行調整。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the path to regaining measles-free status remains difficult. Public health officials emphasize that vaccination is one of the most cost-effective ways to improve human life, comparing its importance to clean drinking water and basic sanitation. While the government has pledged to support timely treatment and better communication, the immediate reality is a nation struggling with a dangerous and highly infectious disease. As the country moves forward, the focus will likely remain on rebuilding the public's trust in medical science and ensuring that children receive the protection they need to stay healthy.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，重拾無麻疹國家地位的道路依然艱難。公共衛生官員強調，疫苗接種是改善人類生活最具成本效益的方式之一，其重要性可比擬潔淨飲用水與基礎衛生設施。雖然政府已承諾支持及時治療並改善溝通，但眼前的現實是，國家正與一種危險且高傳染性的疾病搏鬥。隨著國家向前邁進，焦點可能會持續放在重建公眾對醫學科學的信任，並確保兒童獲得保持健康所需的保護。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A formal classification or standing of a country regarding a specific condition.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此處指國家在國際衛生組織評估下的正式資格，而非一般指的社會地位。文中：The United States has officially lost its measles-free status, a designation that marks the end of 26 years without the disease spreading continuously within the country.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Regularly found and very common among a particular group or in a particular area.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在醫學語境中指疾病已成為該地區常態，而非僅是偶發。文中：The loss of this status does not come with legal penalties or travel restrictions, but it serves as a formal recognition that the virus is now endemic, meaning it is regularly found within the population.

quiz.question: What is the specific reason the Pan American Health Organization (Paho) officially downgraded the US measles status?

options.A: The US had 10 deaths related to measles.
options.B: The virus had been spreading continuously within the country for 12 months.
options.C: Vaccination rates dropped below 95 percent nationwide.
options.D: The American Medical Association requested a review of the status.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，Paho 宣布此決定是因為病毒在美國境內連續傳播了 12 個月。選項 A 雖然文中提到有 10 起死亡案例，但這不是導致失去「無麻疹狀態」的定義條件。選項 C 雖提到 95% 是防疫門檻，但文中並未直接說是因為全國數據低於此門檻才導致降級，而是強調病毒傳播的時間長度。選項 D 則是文中未提及的資訊。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the future of measles in the United States?

options.A: The government will likely implement travel bans to stop the virus.
options.B: The virus will be eradicated quickly if the current administration is replaced.
options.C: The problem is deeply rooted in long-term societal issues rather than just recent political actions.
options.D: Public health experts believe that the measles-free status will be regained within a year.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第六段提到專家警告問題很複雜，不能只歸咎於單一政府，且疫苗錯誤資訊已存在超過二十年。選項 A 與文章第三段提到的「目前沒有法律懲罰或旅行限制」相矛盾。選項 B 過於簡化問題，忽略了文中提到的長期錯誤資訊挑戰。選項 D 文中提到恢復過程「依然困難」，並未給出明確的時間表。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'dynamic' mean in the context of misinformation?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，形容錯誤資訊的角色是「dynamic」，意指其傳播方式與影響力並非靜止不動，而是隨著時間、環境與社群需求不斷演變。選項 B 雖然聽起來有影響力，但非此字在該處的精確定義。選項 C 用於形容人或物體運動，不適用於抽象概念。選項 D 則與文章強調問題複雜、難以解決的語境不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The US government is failing to provide clean drinking water.
options.B: The loss of measles-free status is a result of political malpractice by specific individuals.
options.C: Measles is the most dangerous disease currently affecting the global population.
options.D: The US faces a complex challenge in regaining its measles-free status due to misinformation and declining vaccination rates.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章全面探討了美國失去無麻疹狀態的背景、原因（疫苗接種率下降、錯誤資訊）、政治爭議以及未來面臨的困難，涵蓋了文章的核心論點。選項 A 僅是文中用來比喻疫苗重要性的例子。選項 B 只涵蓋了文章的一部分，忽略了長期存在的結構性問題。選項 C 誇大了文章內容，文章僅指出麻疹是「最具有傳染性的疾病之一」，而非全球最危險的疾病。
